reference.pathophysiology: Oestrogen loss and steroids uncouple remodelling towards thin fragile trabeculae; vitamin D lack blocks mineralisation producing Looser zones and waddle, while Paget drives chaotic mosaic overgrowth with deafness and high ALP.
additionalDifferentials: Osteoporosis versus osteomalacia versus Paget versus myeloma by DEXA Looser ALP and gaps
Fragility versus pathologic by trauma and lysis
Veiled versus renal by D and creatinine
additionalInvestigations: DEXA with calcium phosphate ALP vitamin D
